seo.description: Study Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering in Australia for Indian students. Learn about top universities (Monash, UNSW, QUT, UQ), eligibility, fees, Engineers Australia accreditation, and career opportunities.

hero.title: Study Australian undergraduate electrical engineering programs.
hero.subtitle: Electrical engineering focuses on power generation, renewable energy systems, electronics, telecommunications, and digital automation.

overview: Undergraduate electrical engineering programs in Australia integrate fundamental circuit analysis, power systems, renewable energy, control systems, and advanced electronics.

faq.question: Is it possible for Indian students to study electrical engineering in Australia?
faq.answer: Yes, qualified students with Class 12 mathematics and physics can apply for accredited Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) programs.

faq.question: What is the duration of an Australian degree in electrical engineering?
faq.answer: A standard Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) takes 4 years of full-time study.

faq.question: Does electrical engineering require mathematics?
faq.answer: Yes, senior secondary mathematics is an essential prerequisite for admission.

faq.question: Do Australian universities require NEET for electrical engineering?
faq.answer: No, NEET is exclusively for medical degrees and is not required for engineering programs.

faq.question: How much does electrical engineering cost in Australia?
faq.answer: Annual international tuition typically ranges from AUD 40,000 to AUD 55,000, depending on the university.
